role: Fixed screen-space primary spectrum with secondary response in existing source lights
pictureAuthority: Decoded original MP4 frame; no generated or substituted scenery
measurement: 60 Hz source-derived RMS, flux and 24 logarithmic bands; raw measurements unchanged

primarySpectrum.anchorPolicy: One fixed position and size in each format; source cuts do not move, resize or fade the spectrum
primarySpectrum.interpolation: Each column linearly interpolates adjacent measured frequency bands
primarySpectrum.heightMapping: power = band^0.88 × (0.40 + 0.60 × normalized RMS); height = (0.018 + 0.982 × power) × box height
primarySpectrum.emission: Screen-composited colored shafts with narrow bright cores, vertical opacity falloff and shallow local spill
primarySpectrum.localSpill: Elliptical source-colored light pool, not a duplicated spectrum or claimed physical reflection
primarySpectrum.lyricReservation: Reading boxes move upward if needed to preserve the fixed spectrum and format-specific gap; resulting subject clearance still requires visual review

mask: 640 by 360 source-space highlight extraction restricted to manually authored scene regions; original pixel colors and shapes retained

windows.frequencies: 12 lower bands across left window regions, 12 upper bands across right regions
windows.height: Band energy controls illuminated reach through the existing window floors
windows.contrast: Source windows dim moderately between hits and brighten with the band response

starsAndReflections: Existing bright source details carry local measured response; no new star pattern, particles or wet surfaces are introduced
environmentalBloom: Bounded local source-light emission with 9 px landscape and 13 px portrait blur; never a whole-frame flash
cutProtection: Secondary environmental masks fade over 0.45 seconds at authored shot boundaries; the primary spectrum remains continuous and lyric timing remains independent
readingProtection: Window and star regions exclude selected subject areas; glyph positions remain fixed within each cue and shot host, with a reserved primary-spectrum footprint

timeline.status: provisional; actual-audio listening review and production authorization pending

limits: The primary spectrum is a deliberate screen-space graphic, not a claim of physical anchoring in every shot. Secondary masks and dissolve handoffs are manually sampled, not dense optical-flow tracking. The artistic treatment requires normal-speed review; measured signal identity alone does not prove a convincing appearance. No final render is authorized.

performanceImplementation.environmentBloom: Blur once at640x360 with output-equivalent radius, then composite over unchanged source detail
performanceImplementation.spectrumBloom: One half-scale shadow layer for all48 shafts; crisp shafts and cores remain full-output resolution
performanceImplementation.letterLayout: Cache by cue object, format and shot; reset on scene reload
performanceImplementation.timing: Source frame clock and measured features unchanged
